verdict.rationale: WorkOS RBAC docs explicitly describe defining custom roles/permissions at org level and enforcing them via session JWTs, plus IdP role assignment via SSO/Directory Sync, directly matching the story (workos-docs-3, workos-docs-22, workos-supp-rbac-jwt). Community evidence corroborates the broader SSO/SCIM developer experience though none specifically praises RBAC/JWT enforcement. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that permissions are correctly enforced in production and more detail on JWT claim structure for permission checks.
